title: helminthia comosa subsp. lusitanica
intro: Helminthia comosa subsp. lusitanica, commonly known as Lusitanian helminthia, is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body.
